question: Does a verified maintainer approve retaining generated provider catalog payloads, including any existing API-key or account-route data, in the per-agent SQLite `cache_entries` contract across upgrade and Doctor recovery?
rationale: The implementation moves credential-bearing state across a persistence boundary. The supplied follow-up says this was approved, but the PR is externally associated and protected by the `maintainer` label, so merge authorization should explicitly confirm the durable security and retention contract.

options.title: Confirm SQLite ownership

options.body: Pause the PR and require removal or separate handling of credential-bearing fields before generated catalogs may be persisted in the shared cache contract.
